subject: Suppress core dumps around ASSERT_DEATH and EXPECT_DEATH testing calls (#868)
reason: The change is confined to unit-test infrastructure: it replaces EXPECT_DEATH/ASSERT_DEATH with VMSDK_EXPECT_DEATH/VMSDK_ASSERT_DEATH macros in three test files and adds an RLimitGuard in vmsdk/src/testing_infra/utils.h that sets RLIMIT_CORE to 0 while gtest death tests run, so intentional test crashes stop producing core dumps. No file compiled into the shipped module (nothing under src/ or the non-test parts of vmsdk/) is touched, so the module's runtime behaviour — commands, replies, indexing, coordinator messaging, persistence — is identical on both builds and no scenario can observe a diff
